notes.title: ARCHiTECTUS Update 1.8
notes.content:
Our 8th update aims to add more progression in your business.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/9f19afe9d8e7a8127e709dd971c4ebb44b2b0571.png[/img]

We've added purchasable upgrades, that will make your life a lot easier.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/d3688bee4fccf0fe4c6b9fee39455784a96a6c71.png[/img]

We've also added office material themes, which if fulfilled, will boost the price of your house.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/1cc6a1923aa07469d169eb68d454f9ab435ac1c0.png[/img]

Career mode also gets 2 brand new Contracts to complete.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/ee38332f3e097553e10c10095b00faf0c6c92e64.png[/img]

notes.title: ARCHiTECTUS Update 1.7
notes.content:
Our 7th update is a game changer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/3ecf9924293c8ea0e3234ca246999ce1bba91c88.png[/img]

We know that a game needs goals and progression, so we decided to give you that in the first Career Update. Now you can complete house renovation Contracts to earn money.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/e6fdb0faac8b8bcacb0b48d1133f6abd515ca878.png[/img]

You can use money to buy your very own Office, where you can invest your money in a house.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/5be5aa0046d580efa25653fed6871da4825a46ad.png[/img]

After you're happy wih the house, you can sell it for potential profit. Be warned, a messy house may worth less than the amount of money spent on it. Try to build a house suitable for living for maximum worth.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/9ba45b968d43257138d3a152ff065fbcf1b39e11.png[/img]

A Career Guide is to be expected this week on our YouTube channel.
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCoqrn5VkcqXodd7_YPcjlAQ

tags.feature: Now you can complete house renovation Contracts to earn money.
You can use money to buy your very own Office, where you can invest your money in a house.

notes.title: ARCHiTECTUS Update 1.6
notes.content:
We begin 2021 with a massive 6th update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/821be13ee070fb583cddabe239b2d7f84ad99de1.png[/img]

This month we worked on adding 12 fan requested natural objects with 3 brand new materials to choose from.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/b90c86ef3bcaab50bb389ae738c8a2672057b944.png[/img]

We have also added 32 interactable damaged components. Interacting with them makes them swap between damaged and repaired state. This was added as a teaser for our largest, 7th update that is coming in February.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/48997657f6527560443ee991623aeae6d7c1db7e.png[/img]

As a hint for the 7th update, we've decided not to hide, just disable the 2 new menu buttons that will lead to the added features of the next update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/f02288698689a8a9552042dd363cae622f644843.png[/img]

tags.feature: This month we worked on adding 12 fan requested natural objects with 3 brand new materials to choose from.
We have also added 32 interactable damaged components.

notes.title: ARCHiTECTUS Update 1.5
notes.content:
This month our team worked hard to make the fifth update as good as possible.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/d24fa28bab0ce6c8711684af2c217a4e6d365407.png[/img]

We have added 10 brand new components to the game in the form of fences. Classy House just got updated with these magnificent parts!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/2cac8d31211ea1cc6382a040436c3b598a63f22a.png[/img]

In this update we have finally added localization to the game. Now you can play in Hungarian as well and there are more to come next year. German and Spanish are in the works.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/dbe6a5411e092eaf6687a5213a455cbf933a8e0b.png[/img]

And last, but not least, Steam Workshop is now added! You can share your houses with others and also check out what other's have created. For more info, please check out our Steam Workshop guide.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/4ae0b5f995413fa31e7d7d3a8db7b035d7d7d608.png[/img]

tags.feature: We have added 10 brand new components to the game in the form of fences.
In this update we have finally added localization to the game.
And last, but not least, Steam Workshop is now added!

notes.title: ARCHiTECTUS Update 1.4
notes.content:
The fourth update for ARCHiTECTUS is packed with all sorts of new indoor interactions and components.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/9cafad28554b203ae22427188e624e67380feb49.png[/img]

This month we reworked the animation system from the ground up, allowing you to keep the doors and windows open and much more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/a8bdcf60b6ba05da71be66d9753e926f958895da.png[/img]

We also added an indicator to let you know if you are looking at something that you can interact with. Now you can turn on/off the stove, vent and water flowing from any tap or shower.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/24e17f7f83b9f8cef283873c77824e567b897d3c.png[/img]

The update brings 3 brand new doors to the game with a set of garage doors and frames.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/1c42f8e037019edddb8fb85d54b044a492396c30.png[/img]

You can also try out the brand new curtains and the rocking chair.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/54b21bfab5082fda0f95eb6bf2cad83e287efebb.png[/img]

And finally, don't forget to check out the new updated official save file, Classy House, to see the new components in action.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/60027a1f0b757f9a84f321758ca6cf03cfb5fd90.png[/img]

tags.feature: The fourth update for ARCHiTECTUS is packed with all sorts of new indoor interactions and components.
This month we reworked the animation system from the ground up, allowing you to keep the doors and windows open and much more.
We also added an indicator to let you know if you are looking at something that you can interact with.
Now you can turn on/off the stove, vent and water flowing from any tap or shower.
The update brings 3 brand new doors to the game with a set of garage doors and frames.
You can also try out the brand new curtains and the rocking chair.
And finally, don't forget to check out the new updated official save file, Classy House, to see the new components in action.

notes.title: ARCHiTECTUS Update 1.3
notes.content:
Our third update brings a few new mechanics and content to the game later this week.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/38a58622b474350f7f60032935a7f744cb11c93f.png[/img]

As the update name suggests, now you can place switches and connect multiple lamps to them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/5b57cdd3eef9126ec5b3b4c3a16fddfb77f260d6.png[/img]

The community requested, we delivered. Autosaving is now an option. It will generate backup saves that won't overwrite the actual save file. We still recommend saving manually at the end of a session.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/4175cacd81300425afaf55d1a6a3dc900a558fc8.png[/img]

We also added a Tutorial library for you to access. It will either contain the already activated tips or show all of them, depending on your settings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/e0c6f8a8d5638159a5d7de6f239abbaccad58176.png[/img]

For simplicity, we reworked some of the furnitures and also added a few new ones to the game. It might have minor side effects in your existing savefiles. Check your bedrooms to see if something feels off a bit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/e8fb90a2b10aaecb336b2abf1f21dd3a54e63f7a.png[/img]

Furniture materials also received a well deserved rework to have a bit more depth.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/0a574088c57da363d6e75c0ac531a475746a7de0.png[/img]

And last, but not least you can now get your hands on the new spooky "Aged" material set.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/cfe5656b9932377af07392d787702b65af0f4e33.png[/img]

tags.feature: As the update name suggests, now you can place switches and connect multiple lamps to them.
Autosaving is now an option.
We also added a Tutorial library for you to access.
For simplicity, we reworked some of the furnitures and also added a few new ones to the game.
Furniture materials also received a well deserved rework to have a bit more depth.
And last, but not least you can now get your hands on the new spooky "Aged" material set.

notes.title: ARCHiTECTUS Update 1.2
notes.content:
Our second post-release update which is also our first major update brings a lot to the table.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/e57be37a2e5b1a573526a4b3935ea68176366e60.png[/img]

The Brick By Brick Update comes with 34 brand new components and 10 materials to use.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/678bae808ed8de15671008b37c361319d5964541.png[/img]

Meet Abigail! She'll guide you through the basics of the game in an all-new tutorial system.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/4574d41133cc079ac65400d071ea7c03af9abf1b.png[/img]

Can't quite see what you are doing? Now you can hide selected components that obscure your view.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/25828ee46e228a42dd9c91c0354210ae979d5a2c.png[/img]

And last, but certainly not least you can now explore the official save file of the "Classy House".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/25858465a8d02bbc3991da59c46cd8d80f76cec9.png[/img]

Also, stay tuned for a SpOoOoKy Halloween special made in co-operation with an ARCHiTECTUS fan!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38207672/3c51251d31ba7ce6f1970471aed559a78aeb35df.png[/img]

Meet Abigail! She'll guide you through the basics of the game in an all-new tutorial system.
Now you can hide selected components that obscure your view.
And last, but certainly not least you can now explore the official save file of the "Classy House".
